options.label: 3D renderer
options.description: How DSperate draws the DS's 3D. Software is pixel-exact with the DS and runs on three CPU threads; GPU draws it with Vulkan at the DS's resolution, which frees the CPU but can place a texture pixel early or late.

options.label: Screen layout
options.description: How the two DS screens share the panel. Guide+Y cycles them in game. Has no effect on a dual-screen device, where each screen has its own panel.

choices.label: Side by side, top screen large

options.label: Integer scaling
options.description: Scales the DS screens by whole numbers only, for an even, sharp picture with borders around it.

options.label: Screen filter
options.description: Sharp keeps the DS's pixels square; Smooth blends them (bilinear).

options.label: Colour correction
options.description: Gives the picture the colours of a real DS screen. Off shows the game's own colours.

options.label: VSync
options.description: Waits for the screen's refresh before showing a frame: no tearing.

options.label: Show FPS
options.description: A frames-per-second counter in a corner of the top screen.

notes: Verified against beebono/DSperate tag v3.4.1, src/frontend/sdl. Config is ~/.config/dsperate/dsperate.ini (config.h global_path), read as [section] then key = value lines into 'section.key' (config.cpp Config::load); a value is cut at the first # or ;. DSperate's pause menu changes ONE line in place (Config::store), never rewrites the file. Per-game files ~/.config/dsperate/games/<rom>.ini and games/<GAMECODE>.ini override it; a layout picked with the hotkey is remembered there, and wins over the layout option for that game.

renderer: [video] gpu3d bool, default false (main.cpp DS_GPU3D / video.gpu3d; --gpu3d): the 3D layer on Vulkan, else OpenGL ES 3.1, at 1x; the CPU raster is the exact reference and the fallback. DSperate has no internal-resolution upscale (video.internal_res is retired).

layout: [video] layout vertical|horizontal|single|pip|dominant_v|dominant_h (main.cpp parse_video, default vertical); the seed sets dominant_h. Ignored in dual-window mode (the launcher's --dual-window on a dual-screen board), the fallback's layout there.
integer_scale: [video] integer_scale off|under|over (Disp::parse_int_scale); On is under (letterbox), over crops and is left to the player's file.
smoothing: [video] linear bool, default false: bilinear instead of nearest.
vsync: [video] vsync bool, default true. show_fps: [video] fps bool, default false (the fps hotkey toggles it, unbound).
Left out: aspect (the DS is 4:3 and DSperate always keeps it), resolution (none), anti-aliasing (video.aa, in DSperate's own menu).
